paper.title: Scikit-learn: Machine Learning in Python
paper.reference: Pedregosa et al., Journal of Machine Learning Research 12:2825–2830 (2011)

paper_context.research_question: Can the released scikit-learn pipeline train and evaluate an SVM on a fixed public split without tuning?
paper_context.method: Standardize Iris features, fit an RBF SVM, and score a stratified fixed test split.
paper_context.data_and_splits: Iris dataset distributed by scikit-learn; fixed 70/30 split with random_state=42.
paper_context.training_or_inference: 105 training observations on CPU; no hyperparameter search.
paper_context.evaluation_protocol: One predeclared split; require accuracy no worse than 0.90.
paper_context.limitations: Low-cost API reproduction, not a paper table or a claim of state-of-the-art accuracy.

claims.protocol: One predeclared split; require accuracy no worse than 0.90.
